entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 1. Heard Mr. S. K. Goswami, learned counsel for the petitioner.

2. This application under Section 528 of BNSS has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Sri Raman Choudhury praying for quashing of the proceedings of Misc. D.V. Case No. 30/2024 pending before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup(M), Guwahati.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup(M), Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said DV case has been filed by the respondent No. 2, who is the wife of the present petitioner.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that prior to filing of this case, the respondent No.
2 had filed several cases, namely, case under Section 498A of IPC as well as separate case under Section 406 of IPC and a divorce case.
He submits that the other criminal cases have been stayed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that initially the respondent No. 2 had lodged an FIR before the All Women Police Station alleging domestic violence against the present petitioner on 13.02.2024.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and the respondent No. 2 had parted their company in the year 2022.
He further submits that the said FIR was withdrawn by the respondent No. 2 after arrival of mutual settlement between the parties that they shall file divorce case.
However, though a divorce case has been filed, by the respondent, she is filing multiple other cases only with a view to harass the petitioner.
The other criminal cases has stated herein before have already been stated by the Co-ordinate Page No.# 3/3 Bench of this Court.
5. It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the respondent No. 2 even lodged case against the father and mother of the present petitioner.
However, the said case was also stayed by this Court by order dated 24.06.2024 passed in Criminal Petition No. 699/2024.

6. Issue notice to the respondent No. 2.
7.
The petitioner shall take steps for issuance of notice by registered post with A/D as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable after 4 weeks.

8. In the meanwhile, considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, as discussed in the foregoing paragraphs, further proceedings of Misc. D.V. Case No. 30/2024 pending before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup(M), Guwahati shall remain stayed till next returnable date.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup(M), Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 9. List accordingly.
